title: interrupting of normal workflow in the app
body:
There is a recurring bug in Google Calendar that significantly affects usability.

When I create an event and enter a location in the address field, the application freezes. After that, the only way to continue using the app is to close it completely and open it again. As a result, the event I was creating is lost, including the title, description, time, and other details, and I have to enter everything again from the beginning.

This issue happens repeatedly and makes it very difficult to plan events, especially when the event contains detailed information. The problem seems to be triggered specifically when adding or editing the location field.
This causes loss of data and interrupts normal workflow in the app.
